indication: overactive bladder and urinary incontinence symptoms
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || chewable || take without food
mechanism_of_action: relaxing the muscles in the bladder, improving ability to control urination
side_effects: dry mouth || blurred vision || constipation || dizziness || drowsiness || dyspepsia || headache || joint pain || stomach pain
unsuitable_population: children, elderly, pregnant women, patients with glaucoma, kidney problem, liver disease, myasthenia gravis, personal or family history of 'Long QT syndrome', stomach or intestinal disorder, trouble emptying your bladder
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || avoid moisture, heat, and light
